model.state_convention: Y_i=n_i/n_b, A dot Y = 1; free electron n_e=n_b q dot Y
model.inventory_status: Conditional pilot inputs, not an inferred BBN posterior or isotope-resolved atomic-rate measurement
model.isotope_rate_policy: ElementalElectronicEquality explicitly enabled for H1/D/T, He3/He4, Li6/Li7; no isotope shift or isotope-resolved fit claimed

photon_field.frame: External local isotropic number flux, bin-integrated m^-2 s^-1; flux is c times photon number density
photon_field.quadrature: Split base logarithmic bins at all thresholds and LiI inner-shell edge; geometric bin-centre cross sections times exact integrated number power law
photon_field.ion_yield: Every absorbed photon creates one electron and advances q by one. For neutral Li inner-shell absorption this is explicit coarse-graining, not source-validated final charge/Auger/fluorescence yield.
photon_field.radiative_transfer: Prescribed optically thin UV; no attenuation or recombination-photon feedback

weak_decay.neutron_source: PDG2024 neutron listing; mean lifetime, not half-life
weak_decay.ion_electron_spectator_approximation: T retains its pre-existing bound electron count; no shake-off or bound-state beta branching
weak_decay.pilot_initial_n_T: zero, hence actual pilot decay populations and flux are zero

excluded_processes: photonuclear reactions above the finite UV support
